Trait-only flags are retained for old saves and aggregate forest-care paths. This does not label every choice as mechanically unique.

edges.choice: Comfort the frightened Pokémon
edges.immediateOutcome: You kneel beside {starter} until it feels braver, then walk together to Mira’s lantern stall for help.

edges.choice: Examine the silver seed
edges.immediateOutcome: The seed glows whenever you turn toward Moonwood, so you take it to Mira, the village lantern keeper, to ask what it means.

edges.choice: Check the hill for fallen stars
edges.immediateOutcome: You and {starter} climb the grassy hill above the square, looking for the light that fell from the sky.

edges.choice: Invite Eevee to come with us
edges.immediateOutcome: Eevee steps out from under the stall and joins you; Mira points your little team toward the Moonwood gate.

edges.choice: Borrow Mira’s old star map
edges.immediateOutcome: Mira lends you her map and traces the route through Moonwood, across the river and up to Starfall Tower before showing you to the gate.

edges.choice: Ask where the seed came from
edges.immediateOutcome: Mira says the seed fell from the direction of Starfall Tower, then sends you to the nearby hill to find the beginning of its silver trail.

edges.choice: Remember the three-note song
edges.immediateOutcome: You hum low, high, low until you remember the song, then follow the silver trail downhill to Moonwood’s gate.

edges.choice: Share a snack with Hoothoot
edges.immediateOutcome: Hoothoot eats your snack and decides to come along, flying ahead to show you the Moonwood gate.

edges.choice: Help Bulbasaur untangle the arch
edges.immediateOutcome: Bulbasaur lifts the thorny stems one at a time, opening the arch so you can walk safely into Moonwood.

edges.choice: Let Charmander light the ridge
edges.immediateOutcome: Charmander lights the ridge with its tail, and you follow the visible path around the thorny arch.

edges.choice: Let Squirtle wash the muddy sign
edges.immediateOutcome: Squirtle washes mud off the sign, revealing an arrow toward a brook that leads into Moonwood.

edges.choice: Follow the seed’s soft glow
edges.immediateOutcome: The seed lights a narrow gap beside the thorny arch, and you and {starter} squeeze through to the forest path.

edges.choice: Lift the branch and repair the nest
edges.immediateOutcome: You repair the fallen nest and set it safely in a low tree, then follow the ridge path down into Moonwood.

edges.choice: Mark the nest so Mira can help
edges.immediateOutcome: You mark the nest on a branch for Mira to find, then follow the carved arrow down to the brook.

edges.choice: Keep the message safe
edges.immediateOutcome: You tuck the letter safely into your pocket and follow the stream into Moonwood.

edges.choice: Float a reply: “We are coming”
edges.immediateOutcome: You float your reply in the bottle, and a passing Hoothoot lifts it toward the mountain while you follow the stream into Moonwood.

edges.choice: Stop and free Pikachu
edges.immediateOutcome: You stop beside Pikachu and carefully loosen the silver ivy while {starter} holds the stems still.

edges.choice: Study the blinking mushrooms
edges.immediateOutcome: Pikachu wiggles free of the loose loop and waves goodbye before you follow the nearby mushrooms.

edges.choice: Ask the trees to speak one at a time
edges.immediateOutcome: The leaves fall quiet, loosen Pikachu’s ivy and whisper one clear instruction: follow the roots to the oldest tree.

edges.choice: Welcome Pikachu to the team
edges.immediateOutcome: Pikachu chooses to travel with you and leads you a few steps along the glowing mushroom path.

edges.choice: Ask Pikachu to protect the forest
edges.immediateOutcome: Pikachu promises to guard Moonwood, then points you toward the oldest tree before waving goodbye.

edges.choice: Follow the constellation we solved
edges.immediateOutcome: The stars light up in the order you solved, showing a trail through the ferns to the oldest tree.

edges.choice: Follow the brightest cluster
edges.immediateOutcome: You follow the brightest mushrooms into a hollow tree, where the light suddenly breaks into laughter.

edges.choice: Wait and draw the whole pattern
edges.immediateOutcome: Your drawing shows that the blinking lights all point toward the same ancient tree, so you follow that path.

edges.choice: Let our kindness guide a path through the ivy
edges.immediateOutcome: You ask the ivy for a safe path without breaking its stems; it bends aside and leads you straight to a mossy clearing.

edges.choice: Tell a story about our first adventure
edges.immediateOutcome: Gastly laughs at your story and opens a tiny doorway inside the hollow tree to its secret reading room.

edges.choice: Explain why we must help the sky
edges.immediateOutcome: Gastly stops giggling when you explain the missing stars and guides you back outside to the oldest tree.

edges.choice: Borrow the astronomer’s notebook about Lumi
edges.immediateOutcome: You borrow notes explaining that Lumi is a Clefairy caring for Shinx, then Gastly leads you out to the lens clearing.

edges.choice: Copy a hidden mountain route
edges.immediateOutcome: You copy the old mountain route, then Gastly leads you through a short tunnel to the lens clearing.

edges.choice: Learn the archive’s three-note greeting
edges.immediateOutcome: You practice the archive’s low-high-low greeting, then follow Gastly out to the lens clearing.

edges.choice: Answer: “Kindness”
edges.immediateOutcome: “Kindness grows when we pass it on,” the tree agrees, opening its root door to the clearing behind it.

edges.choice: Answer: “A flame”
edges.immediateOutcome: “One flame can light another without going out,” the tree agrees, opening its root door to the clearing behind it.

edges.choice: Ask Bulbasaur to speak with the roots
edges.immediateOutcome: Bulbasaur touches the roots with its vines and listens; the tree answers in a low rumble, then lifts its roots into a doorway for you.

edges.choice: Take the lens and a rescue rope
edges.immediateOutcome: You pack the crescent lens and rescue rope, then follow the tree’s riverside path toward Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Take the lens and a rune key
edges.immediateOutcome: You pack the crescent lens and rune key, then follow the tree’s riverside path toward Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Leave the tools and plant a thank-you seed
edges.immediateOutcome: You plant an ordinary seed in thanks, keep the silver seed and lens, and follow the tree’s riverside path toward Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Help Lapras reach deep water
edges.immediateOutcome: You and {starter} dig a small channel from the river to Lapras’s shallow pool.

edges.choice: Repair the ferry with fallen wood
edges.immediateOutcome: You replace the ferry’s broken boards with fallen wood, then check the rope before anyone steps aboard.

edges.choice: Explore the waterfall on foot
edges.immediateOutcome: You follow the bank upstream and find a dry ledge behind the waterfall.

edges.choice: Use our clues to find the astronomer’s cave
edges.immediateOutcome: You match the crescent on your map or letter to the moon-shaped marks along the bank and find the cave’s open side entrance.

edges.choice: Accept Lapras’s friendship
edges.immediateOutcome: Lapras carries you safely to a little island at the foot of the mountain, promising to stay nearby on the river.

edges.choice: Ask Lapras to guide lost travelers
edges.immediateOutcome: Lapras stays to guide other travelers while you walk back to Psyduck’s ferry.

edges.choice: Use Squirtle’s water to widen the channel
edges.immediateOutcome: Squirtle widens the channel with a gentle stream, and grateful Lapras carries you to the island at the foot of the mountain.

edges.choice: Use our rescue rope for a sturdy knot
edges.immediateOutcome: Your rescue rope holds the ferry safely, and you cross to the island at the foot of the mountain.

edges.choice: Weave a new rope from long reeds
edges.immediateOutcome: You braid a strong reed rope and cross safely by ferry to the island at the foot of the mountain.

edges.choice: Help Psyduck cross first
edges.immediateOutcome: You weave a safe ferry rope and help Psyduck cross first; it invites you into its reed workshop beside the far bank.

edges.choice: Build floating lanterns with Psyduck
edges.immediateOutcome: You and Psyduck set floating lanterns along the bank, then follow the short causeway to the island.

edges.choice: Map Psyduck’s quiet reed channel
edges.immediateOutcome: Psyduck marks a quiet river route and the tower’s old water passage on your map, then walks with you to the island.

edges.choice: Learn Psyduck’s calming three-note tune
edges.immediateOutcome: You learn Psyduck’s calming low-high-low tune, then walk together along the causeway to the island.

edges.choice: Enter the doorway opened by our melody
edges.immediateOutcome: Your three notes open the door, and you step into a dry cave behind the falling water.

edges.choice: Leave the bells and follow the river
edges.immediateOutcome: You leave the bells alone and follow the riverbank to a stone causeway leading onto the island.

edges.choice: Sing the melody learned on our journey
edges.immediateOutcome: You sing the melody you learned earlier; the bells answer, and the door opens into a dry cave.

edges.choice: Explore the safe path around the falls
edges.immediateOutcome: The safe path curves around the waterfall and reaches a causeway leading onto the island.

edges.choice: Read how to open the lens gently
edges.immediateOutcome: You learn that friends can open the sphere by helping Lumi feel safe, then take the cave’s lower exit onto the island causeway.

edges.choice: Copy the tower’s hidden stairway
edges.immediateOutcome: You copy the tower’s hidden stairway, then take the cave’s lower exit onto the island causeway.

edges.choice: Promise to help both Pokémon
edges.immediateOutcome: You promise to help both Lumi and Shinx, then follow their footprints uphill toward Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Collect the golden speck for later
edges.immediateOutcome: You catch the golden speck in your lens, where it lights their footprints up the mountain.

edges.choice: Ask the river to keep their secret
edges.immediateOutcome: You promise to share the memory only with people who can help, then follow the friends’ footprints up the mountain.

edges.choice: Wait for the calm and cross together
edges.immediateOutcome: You wait for a quiet moment in the wind and cross the bridge together to a sheltered nook.

edges.choice: Follow the promise trail Lapras revealed
edges.immediateOutcome: Lapras sings from the river below, and you follow the glowing Promise Trail along the mountainside.

edges.choice: Take the longer stone path
edges.immediateOutcome: You take the longer stone path around the bridge and climb to a lookout above the clouds.

edges.choice: Let Bulbasaur anchor the bridge with vines
edges.immediateOutcome: Bulbasaur wraps its vines around the bridge posts to keep the boards steady while everyone crosses to a sheltered nook.

edges.choice: Help Altaria guide the flock to the cloud-platform
edges.immediateOutcome: You guide Altaria’s little birds onto the cloud-platform, and the grateful flock carries you to the observatory roof.

edges.choice: Read the wind marks and take the stone steps
edges.immediateOutcome: The wind marks point to a sheltered flight of stone steps, so you follow them toward the tower.

edges.choice: Ask Altaria for a sheltered path to the berry nook
edges.immediateOutcome: Altaria shows you a path behind the rocks that leads safely to the cloudberry nook.

edges.choice: Carry the scarf to its owner
edges.immediateOutcome: You tuck Shinx’s scarf into your pack and follow the path toward the tower, stopping at a sheltered nook ahead.

edges.choice: Tie it to a marker for other travelers
edges.immediateOutcome: You tie the scarf to a trail marker where other travelers can see it, then follow the path to a sheltered nook.

edges.choice: Keep our promise and follow the hidden stair to Lumi
edges.immediateOutcome: You stay on the hidden stair until it reaches Lumi’s door, keeping the promise you made beside the river.

edges.choice: Trade a little food for the feather
edges.immediateOutcome: You share some food, and Altaria gives you a warm cloud feather before pointing out the nearby observatory.

edges.choice: Repair her cracked berry bowl
edges.immediateOutcome: You repair Altaria’s berry bowl, and she thanks you by showing you the sheltered way to the nearby observatory.

edges.choice: Tell her what we learned about Lumi
edges.immediateOutcome: Altaria listens to what you learned about Lumi and explains that sharing warmth will help, then shows you the nearby observatory.

edges.choice: Open the roof with our repaired mechanism
edges.immediateOutcome: Your repaired mechanism turns, and you climb the stairs as the observatory roof opens.

edges.choice: Accept Pikachu’s help with the old motor
edges.immediateOutcome: Pikachu gives the motor a small, steady spark, opening the roof so you can climb up.

edges.choice: Look for a hand crank with {starter}
edges.immediateOutcome: You and {starter} find a hand crank and turn it together until the roof opens.

edges.choice: Climb the safe outside stair together
edges.immediateOutcome: The outside stair brings you to a manual latch above the frozen controls, and you lift it to open the roof.

edges.choice: Cross slowly, checking on every friend
edges.immediateOutcome: You wait for each stepping-stone to glow steadily and cross together to Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Find the sheltered stair beneath the roof
edges.immediateOutcome: You find a solid stair beneath the platform and follow it around the gap to Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Follow the hidden route our clues reveal
edges.immediateOutcome: Your earlier discovery reveals a sheltered passage with a diagram of the sphere’s warm-light setting, which you copy before reaching Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Ask Charmander to warm the frosted stones
edges.immediateOutcome: Charmander gently melts the frost, making the glowing stepping-stones safe to cross to Starfall Tower.

edges.choice: Knock and introduce ourselves
edges.immediateOutcome: You knock and say your names; Lumi opens the door and invites you inside.

edges.choice: Call gently: “Lumi, we want to help”
edges.immediateOutcome: You call Lumi’s name softly and explain that you came to help; she opens the door.

edges.choice: Return the scarf before speaking
edges.immediateOutcome: You hold out the scarf you found, and Lumi opens the door with a grateful smile.

edges.choice: Sit beside Lumi and listen
edges.immediateOutcome: You sit quietly beside Lumi, and she begins to tell you why she borrowed the stars.

edges.choice: Show Lumi the astronomer’s notebook
edges.immediateOutcome: You share what the astronomer’s notes taught you, and Lumi explains what happened to Shinx.

edges.choice: Suggest moving the sphere to the village
edges.immediateOutcome: Lumi agrees that the village could help, but asks you to choose how to carry the warmth before moving the sphere.

edges.choice: Keep our river promise and share the heart ring
edges.immediateOutcome: Lumi remembers your river promise and trusts you to place your hand on the heart ring.

edges.choice: Tell Lumi she will not face this alone
edges.immediateOutcome: You promise Lumi that your friends will help her, and she turns the sphere so you can study its rings together.

edges.choice: Let Shinx choose what he needs
edges.immediateOutcome: Shinx asks to stay warm and close to Lumi, so you study the rings for a way to help them both.

edges.choice: Share the feather’s soft warmth
edges.immediateOutcome: You tuck the cloud feather around Shinx; feeling its warmth, Lumi relaxes and shows you the sphere’s rings.

edges.choice: Prepare to release the stars to the sky
edges.immediateOutcome: You turn the sky ring toward the window, ready to return the missing stars.

edges.choice: Gather everyone around the heart ring
edges.immediateOutcome: You gather close to Lumi and place your hands beside the heart ring.

edges.choice: Carry the earth ring to the garden balcony
edges.immediateOutcome: Lumi carries the sphere with you onto the garden balcony, where you set the earth ring beside your silver seed.

edges.choice: Follow our plan and bring the closed sphere to Mira
edges.immediateOutcome: Keeping the sphere closed and Shinx warm, you and Lumi follow your village plan down to Mira’s waiting lanterns.

edges.choice: Make a warm nest with the cloud feather
edges.immediateOutcome: You shape the cloud feather into a warm nest for Shinx, giving Lumi the courage to release the stars.

edges.choice: Let Charmander keep Shinx safely warm
edges.immediateOutcome: Charmander lends gentle warmth beside Shinx’s blanket nest, and Lumi finally feels ready to let go.

edges.choice: Release the stars and carry Shinx home
edges.immediateOutcome: You wrap Shinx warmly first, then release the stars and take the sheltered path down to Mira.

edges.choice: Hum a healing lullaby as we open the ring
edges.immediateOutcome: You hum a gentle three-note lullaby; Lumi turns the heart ring to share its warmth, then opens the sky ring in time with your song.

edges.choice: Build a sanctuary here with Lumi
edges.immediateOutcome: You and Lumi decide to turn the tower into a safe home for Pokémon who need care.

edges.choice: Link Pikachu’s spark to the village lanterns
edges.immediateOutcome: Pikachu sends a gentle spark through the lantern wires while your circle shares its warmth with the village below.

edges.choice: Sing the three-note song together
edges.immediateOutcome: You sing the three-note melody together, and the heart ring opens to the rhythm you remember.

edges.choice: Bring the circle of warmth to Willowbrook
edges.immediateOutcome: You carry the sphere down together, and Mira gathers the village around it to share the warmth.

edges.choice: Plant a starlight garden in Willowbrook
edges.immediateOutcome: You carry the silver seed down to Willowbrook and plant it in the village garden.

edges.choice: Let Bulbasaur grow a living sky-vine
edges.immediateOutcome: Bulbasaur helps you carry the seed down to Willowbrook, then guides its roots into a living sky-vine.

edges.choice: Save the seed and open a tower sanctuary
edges.immediateOutcome: You save the seed in a pot and return inside with Lumi to make the tower a safe home.

edges.choice: Plant star reeds along Psyduck’s lantern trail
edges.immediateOutcome: You carry the silver seed down to Psyduck’s lantern trail, where its roots grow into glowing reeds.
